description: A folder of the server: names, folders first, sizes, times, and whether read_file and edit_file accept each. Paths are relative to the server folder: `config/paper-global.yml`, `logs/latest.log`. Files under logs/ need logs:read, the rest files:read. WorldAPI's folder, hidden files, keys, databases, and jars stay hidden. configs true lists instead the server's and each plugin's config files (needs files:read).
